newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells 1,372 tonnes of lead.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells 1,372 tonnes of lead.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center announced it sold 1,372 tonnes of lead for a total amount of $940,050.25 or an average of 31.08 cents per pound.
The bids were opened on Feb 6.

The buyers were: Louisiana Lead Products, 20 tonnes at 32.51 cents per lb; East Penn Manufacturing, 300 tonnes at 31.71 to 31.26 cents per lb; Lead Products Co, 80 tonnes at 31.51 cents per lb; Ney Smelting & Refining, 140 tonnes at 31.45 to 30.86 cents per lb; Hirsch Metals Corp, 40 tonnes at 31.44 cents per lb; Canfield Technologies, 80 tonnes at 31.40 cents per lb; Amerway Inc, 60 tonnes at 31.21 cents per lb; Parks Pioneer Metals, 40 tonnes at 30.82 to 30.72 cents per lb; and Powerlab Inc, 612 tonnes at 30.70 cents per lb.
The next bid opening for lead is Thursday, Mar 6.
